_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 3 — IAS 19 / RJ 271 employee-benefit pension accounting. Six new schemas (PensionPlan, ActuarialValuation, PensionMovement, PensionAssumptionSensitivity, PensionAssetDetail, PensionDisclosureTabel) declaring the defined-benefit (PUC) and defined-contribution measurement, roll-forward, sensitivity, fair-value asset breakdown and jaarrekening disclosure surface entirely as declarative metadata per ADR-031: schema fields + x-openregister-lifecycle (draft → approved → locked on ActuarialValuation, draft → active → terminated on PensionPlan) + x-openregister-aggregations (roll-forward closing balances, sensitivity deltas, disclosure-table generation). The lifecycle preconditions that require cross-field / cross-schema completeness checks the declarative requires: clause cannot yet express are referenced as OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\PensionIas19Guard:<method> (ADR-031 exception path; fail-closed; real OpenRegister ObjectService API per ADR-022). DB plans MUST carry methodology=PUC; DC plans are blocked from DBO/sensitivity workflows; discount rate is flagged when sourced from government bonds; OCI remeasurements are non-recycling. Seed objects ship two pension plans (NL Standard DB Regeling, NL Standard DC Regeling) and one sensitivity template per design.md; operators customise per administration on first use. No PHP actuarial calculation service is authored.

PensionPlan.title: Pension Plan
PensionPlan.description: Regeling description for an IAS 19 / RJ 271 employee-benefit pension plan: plan type (DB/DC/CDC/hybrid), accrual, eligibility, provider, governance, participant counts and the optional HRMQ deelnemersbestand link. DB plans drive full PUC measurement; DC plans get light disclosure only.

planType.description: Plan classification. DB drives full PUC measurement; DC gets light disclosure per IAS 19 §53.
planType.title: Plan Type

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (NL default for this spec).
country.title: Country

funded.description: Whether the plan has segregated plan assets.
funded.title: Funded

provider.description: Provider name (e.g. pensioenfonds, verzekeraar, eigen beheer).
provider.title: Provider

providerLEI.description: Legal Entity Identifier of the institutional provider.
providerLEI.title: Provider Lei

eligibilityRules.description: Eligibility criteria (e.g. all employees age 21+ with >1 year service).
eligibilityRules.title: Eligibility Rules

accrualRate.description: Annual DB accrual rate as a fraction of pensioengrondslag (e.g. 0.01875 for 1.875%).
accrualRate.title: Accrual Rate

pensionableSalaryDefinition.description: Definition of salary used for accrual.
pensionableSalaryDefinition.example: Bruto jaarsalaris inclusief vaste toeslagen, minus AOW-franchise
pensionableSalaryDefinition.title: Pensionable Salary Definition

linkedHrmqGroup.description: Optional reference to an HRMQ pension-administration group for annual deelnemersbestand validation. The HRMQ contract is captured declaratively in the PensionPlan x-openregister-hrmq-roster-source block (Task 19).
linkedHrmqGroup.title: Linked Hrmq Group

linkedProvisionId.description: Optional FK to the bookkeeping-voorzieningen-claims Provision record that carries the cumulative DBO on the balance sheet. When set, the voorzieningen-claims provision-closure flow consumes the latest PensionMovement.dboClosing for the linked plan and updates the provision balance accordingly (— pension provision linkage). Null when voorzieningen-claims is not yet provisioned in the administration; the linkage falls back to the standard DBO balance-sheet line.
linkedProvisionId.title: Linked Provision ID

governanceDocument.description: File URI to the regeling / governance charter, archived in docudesk (ADR-022 — no app-local storage).
governanceDocument.title: Governance Document

notes.description: Free-text notes on plan history, amendments, governance.
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this plan belongs to; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

active.description: Live plan accruing benefits; actuarial valuations may be recorded against it.

terminated.description: Plan ended; only run-off obligation remains.

activate.label: Activate plan
activate.description: Activate once the plan type, framework and (for DB) accrual rate + pensionable-salary definition are complete.

pause.label: Pause accrual
pause.description: Suspend further accrual while retaining the obligation.

resume.label: Resume accrual
resume.description: Resume accrual on a paused plan.

terminate.label: Terminate plan
terminate.description: Terminate the plan; only run-off obligation remains.

x-openregister-hrmq-roster-source.description: Declarative HRMQ deelnemersbestand contract consumed by hrmq.pension-administration when PensionPlan.linkedHrmqGroup is set. The annual reconciliation job queries the linked HRMQ group for the active medewerkers and writes the count + roster-hash back into the most-recent draft ActuarialValuation; the roster is signed off via ValuationLifecycle.rosterReconciled, which is enforced by PensionIas19Guard:canLockValuation before the valuation can be locked into the jaarrekening. The contract is also the hook point for the >5% divergence warning required by the scenario.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pension Plan is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

ActuarialValuation.title: Actuarial Valuation
ActuarialValuation.description: Per-balansdatum measurement of a DB plan's defined-benefit obligation (DBO) and plan assets, with the actuarial assumptions and actuaris sign-off. Projected Unit Credit (PUC) methodology is mandatory for DB plans; the discount rate must be market-referenced and is flagged when a government-bond source is used. netPensionLiability = dboGross − planAssetsFairValue + assetCeilingApplied (IFRIC 14).

plan.description: FK to the PensionPlan being valued.
plan.title: Plan

actuaryCertificationNumber.description: Registration / certification identifier of the actuaris.
actuaryCertificationNumber.title: Actuary Certification Number

methodology.description: Measurement methodology. MUST be PUC for DB plans per IAS 19 §67; DC for contribution-only plans.
methodology.title: Methodology

discountRateGovernmentBondFlag.description: True when the discount rate is sourced from government bonds; surfaces the IAS 19 §83 warning for accountant review. Not an error — flagged, not blocked.
discountRateGovernmentBondFlag.title: Discount Rate Government Bond Flag

withdrawalRate.description: Expected employee withdrawal / resignation rate, percent.
withdrawalRate.title: Withdrawal Rate

planAssetsFairValue.description: Fair value of plan assets in EUR.
planAssetsFairValue.title: Plan Assets Fair Value

assetCeilingApplied.description: Asset-ceiling adjustment per IFRIC 14 when overfunded; negative reduces a net asset.
assetCeilingApplied.title: Asset Ceiling Applied

netPensionLiability.description: Computed dboGross − planAssetsFairValue + assetCeilingApplied; positive = net liability, negative = net asset.
netPensionLiability.title: Net Pension Liability

valuationReport.description: File URI to the full actuarial report, archived in docudesk (ADR-022).
valuationReport.title: Valuation Report

approvalStatus.description: Actuarial valuation lifecycle status. CONSUMED from decidesk Decision outcome; the approvalStatus is driven by decisionOutcome — shillinq does not own the approval transition.
approvalStatus.title: Approval Status

approvedBy.description: Name/email of the approver — mirrored from the decidesk Decision record.
approvedBy.title: Approved By

approvedAt.description: Timestamp of approval — mirrored from the decidesk Decision outcome.
approvedAt.title: Approved At

decisionRef.description: Decidesk Decision id for the actuaris sign-off. Written only by the decidesk registry callback.
decisionRef.title: Decision Ref

decisionOutcome.description: Mirror of the decidesk decision outcome. Written only by the registry callback.
decisionOutcome.title: Decision Outcome

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Actuarial inputs being entered (DBO, assumptions, plan assets).

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Accountant has approved the discount-rate assumption and methodology; ready for roll-forward and disclosure.

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Locked after the jaarrekening is finalised. Immutable; corrections are journalised as amendments, never deletions.

approve.label: Approve valuation
approve.description: Approve once the discount-rate assumption is accountant-signed and (for DB plans) methodology=PUC.

lock.label: Lock valuation
lock.description: Lock the approved valuation when the jaarrekening is finalised; the HRMQ roster must be reconciled before lock.

reopen.label: Return to draft

PensionMovement.title: Pension Movement
PensionMovement.description: Per-period roll-forward of DBO and plan assets, split into the three IAS 19R buckets: service + past service + settlement (P&L), net interest (P&L) and actuarial gain/loss (OCI, non-recycling per IAS 19 §122). dboClosing, planAssetsClosing, netPensionMovementPL and netPensionMovementOCI are computed roll-forward fields. Past service cost from a plan amendment is posted directly to P&L on the amendment date.

pastServiceCost.description: Past service cost from a plan amendment, posted directly to P&L on the amendment date. Negative when a benefit reduction.
pastServiceCost.title: Past Service Cost

netInterestCost.description: Net interest = discount rate × opening net pension liability (P&L).
netInterestCost.title: Net Interest Cost

actuarialLossGainDBO.description: Total actuarial change on DBO (OCI). Negative = gain, positive = loss on the obligation.
actuarialLossGainDBO.title: Actuarial Loss Gain Dbo

dueToDemographicChanges.description: Portion of the DBO actuarial change due to mortality/disability/withdrawal (OCI).
dueToDemographicChanges.title: Due To Demographic Changes

dueToFinancialChanges.description: Portion due to discount-rate / inflation change (OCI).
dueToFinancialChanges.title: Due To Financial Changes

dueToExperienceAdjustments.description: Portion due to actual vs assumed experience (OCI).
dueToExperienceAdjustments.title: Due To Experience Adjustments

dboClosing.description: Computed dboOpening + serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost + actuarialLossGainDBO − benefitsPaid.
dboClosing.title: Dbo Closing

expectedReturnOnAssets.description: Expected return = discount rate × opening assets (EUR).
expectedReturnOnAssets.title: Expected Return On Assets

employerContributions.description: Contributions paid by the employer (EUR). For DC plans this is the only pension cost recognised.
employerContributions.title: Employer Contributions

planAssetsClosing.description: Computed planAssetsOpening + expectedReturnOnAssets + actuarialGainLossAssets + employerContributions + employeeContributions − benefitsPaidFromAssets.
planAssetsClosing.title: Plan Assets Closing

netPensionMovementPL.description: Computed serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost − gainOnSettlement; total P&L charge.
netPensionMovementPL.title: Net Pension Movement Pl

netPensionMovementOCI.description: Computed actuarialLossGainDBO − actuarialGainLossAssets; total OCI remeasurement, non-recycling.
netPensionMovementOCI.title: Net Pension Movement Oci

linkedJournalEntries.description: References to GL journal entries created from this movement (T2 GL integration).
linkedJournalEntries.title: Linked Journal Entries

notes.description: Free-text narrative on the period (e.g. plan amendment, rate change).
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

pensionRollForward.description: Declarative shape of the per-period DBO + plan-asset roll-forward. dboClosing carries the opening balance plus all movement buckets; planAssetsClosing rolls the asset side; netPensionMovementPL and netPensionMovementOCI partition the period charge into the disjoint P&L and OCI buckets per IAS 19R. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the prior-period carry, the same arithmetic is recomputed from the prior PensionMovement closing balance + current ActuarialValuation via the real ObjectService API.

dboClosing.expression: dboOpening + serviceCostCurrent + pastServiceCost + netInterestCost + actuarialLossGainDBO - benefitsPaid

planAssetsClosing.expression: planAssetsOpening + expectedReturnOnAssets + actuarialGainLossAssets + employerContributions + employeeContributions - benefitsPaidFromAssets

x-openregister-posting-recipe.description: Declarative GL posting recipe for PensionMovement, consumed by the T1 bookkeeping-general-ledger JournalEntry materialiser. Each bucket maps to a `bookkeeping-general-ledger` JournalEntry whose materialised GLTransaction posts the period charge to the configured chart-of-accounts range. The recipe is declarative: the JournalEntry orchestrator reads it on PensionMovement transition to `posted` and emits one JournalEntry per non-zero bucket; ids land in `PensionMovement.linkedJournalEntries`. Account ranges follow the standard Dutch SBR/RGS bookkeeping hierarchy (4xxx personeelslasten, 6xxx financiële lasten, 8xxx OCI/eigen vermogen) and may be overridden per administration via the chart-of-accounts mapping.

buckets.name: serviceCost
buckets.description: IAS 19 service cost + past service cost - gain on settlement → personeelslasten (P&L bucket 1).

buckets.name: netInterest
buckets.description: IAS 19 net interest on the net pension liability → financiële lasten (P&L bucket 2).

buckets.name: remeasurementOCI
buckets.description: Actuarieel resultaat (DBO + assets) → OCI account (OCI bucket 3); marked non-recycling so the GL engine MUST refuse any later JournalEntry that moves this balance to a P&L account.

x-openregister-deferred-tax-hint.description: Declarative deferred-tax detection hint consumed by bookkeeping-deferred-tax. PensionMovement creates timing differences between the commercial (IFRS / RJ 271) measurement of the pension liability and its tax basis (in NL: pension provisions are typically only deductible when contributions are paid out, so the commercial provision creates a deductible temporary difference / DTA). The detector reads this hint and emits TemporaryDifference records with category=pension per fiscal period per administration; the OCI component flows to TaxProvision.recognisedInOCI.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pension Movement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

PensionAssumptionSensitivity.title: Pension Assumption Sensitivity
PensionAssumptionSensitivity.description: DBO sensitivity line for one assumption delta on one ActuarialValuation per IAS 19 §145. Each DB valuation generates eight lines: discount rate ±0.5pp, salary growth ±0.5pp, mortality ±1yr, inflation ±0.5pp. Records the effect on DBO, service cost and (optionally) net interest.

direction.description: Delta applied, e.g. +0.5pp / -0.5pp for rates, +1yr / -1yr for mortality.
direction.title: Direction

effectOnDBO.description: Impact on DBO in EUR; sign matches the direction's effect.
effectOnDBO.title: Effect On Dbo

effectOnServiceCost.description: Impact on service cost in EUR.
effectOnServiceCost.title: Effect On Service Cost

effectOnNetInterest.description: Impact on net interest cost in EUR.
effectOnNetInterest.title: Effect On Net Interest

notes.description: Free-text explanation (e.g. discount-rate rise lowers DBO).
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

pensionSensitivityDeltas.description: Declarative shape of the per-assumption sensitivity recomputation. For each of the eight standard deltas the base DBO + service cost are recomputed and the difference stored as effectOnDBO / effectOnServiceCost. When the engine cannot recompute the actuarial base, the actuaris-supplied effect is entered directly and validated for completeness (eight lines per DB valuation).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pension Assumption Sensitivity is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

PensionAssetDetail.title: Pension Asset Detail
PensionAssetDetail.description: Plan-asset breakdown by category with the IFRS 13 fair-value level (1 quoted / 2 observable / 3 unobservable) for one ActuarialValuation. The per-valuation category fair values must sum to ActuarialValuation.planAssetsFairValue.

fairValue.description: Fair value of assets in this category in EUR.
fairValue.title: Fair Value

level.description: IFRS 13 fair-value level: 1 quoted, 2 observable, 3 unobservable.
level.title: Level

notes.description: Free-text notes (e.g. real estate at indexed cost, revaluation pending).
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pension Asset Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

PensionDisclosureTabel.title: Pension Disclosure Table
PensionDisclosureTabel.description: Auto-generated jaarrekening disclosure table per IAS 19 §135–149 for a plan on a balansdatum. tableContent holds the structured disclosure (assumptions, DBO movement, asset movement, P&L + OCI summary, asset breakdown by category + fair-value level, duration, expected employer contribution) suitable for jaarrekening notes; for DC plans it carries only the contribution amount + regeling summary.

tableContent.description: Full disclosure table as structured JSON, auto-generated from PensionMovement + PensionAssetDetail + PensionAssumptionSensitivity records; renderable as Markdown/HTML for jaarrekening notes. For DC plans, only contribution + regeling summary.
tableContent.title: Table Content

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

pensionDisclosureGeneration.description: Declarative shape of the disclosure-table generation. Consumes the completed PensionMovement (DBO + asset movement, P&L/OCI split), PensionAssetDetail (category + fair-value level) and PensionAssumptionSensitivity (eight sensitivity lines) records for the plan on the valuation date and emits a single PensionDisclosureTabel with all IAS 19 §135–149 line items. When the engine cannot template the merge, the same structure is built from the source records via the real ObjectService API.

x-openregister-disclosure-source.description: Declarative data-source contract consumed by bookkeeping-financial-statements jaarrekening Note renderer. The Note schema's pension disclosure section reads PensionDisclosureTabel.tableContent for the (administrationId, valuationDate) tuple when status is `approved` or `published`, eliminating any manual copy/paste into the jaarrekening. When the renderer cannot project the JSON column directly, the same data is fetched via the real ObjectService API per ADR-022.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pension Disclosure Table is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
